notes: There is no single variant create. The mutation takes an array, so a loop over REST calls becomes one call with many variants.
The strategy argument decides what happens to the product's standalone default variant. Leaving it unset keeps the default behaviour.
The product ID is required as a separate argument, not carried inside each variant.
The REST call needed only the variant ID. This one also needs the parent product ID, which the REST caller may never have held.
allowPartialUpdates defaults to false, so one invalid variant in the array fails every variant in the call. REST failed one at a time.
Inventory quantity is not set here. Quantities move through the inventory operations.
The argument is spelled variantsIds, not variantIds. It is an easy typo and the error it produces does not point at the spelling.
Deleting several variants is one call rather than several.
